item.title: Phys Fuzz 0.2: a second circuit, Tokyo '68
item.description: Phys Fuzz 0.2: a second circuit, Tokyo '68 Phys Fuzz is the fuzz plugin where the knobs are component failures. It doesn't model the sound of a pedal, it solves the circuit.
